title: Vectorised operations instead of Python loops

videos.script: Convert a year of temperatures to Fahrenheit. The first way most people write it is a loop. {{loop}} Fetch a value, multiply, add, append. Three hundred and sixty-five times. {{times}} NumPy lets you write the conversion once, for the whole column. {{once}} The loop still happens. It happens in compiled code, all at once. {{compiled}} On a few hundred thousand values, that is more than a hundred times faster. {{faster}} This lesson is about that habit. Functions that work element by element. Reductions that turn a table into one number per row, or per column. {{axis}} Running totals, and the position of the largest value. {{running}} And the two cases where the loop stays. When each value depends on the one before. And when the arrays stop fitting in memory. {{end}}
